name: Box-baffle quilt
summary: A quilt with a wall of cloth between the two faces of each cell. Loose down stays in its place and gives even warmth.
how: Sew strips of cloth between the outer shell and the inner layer to form cells.
Blow a measured weight of down into each cell.
Close each cell and sew a bar tack at the end of each row.

origin.note: Eddie Bauer makes the first quilted goose-down jacket after a near-fatal trip in the cold.

adoptions.via: The Eddie Bauer shop sells the first quilted goose-down jacket.
